name: codex-collaboration-event-gate
description: Coordinate native Codex subagents with one interruptible event subscription and no polling.

interface.shortDescription: Event-driven completion gate for Codex subagents
interface.longDescription: Tracks native Codex subagent lifecycle events, rewrites one authorized wait to the maximum timeout, preserves user steering, and denies final while workers remain.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate bounded Codex workers with the event gate.
